services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Note: Currently, we are only booking field trips through December 17th. We will begin booking spring field trips in January. Beginning in January, we will be transitioning out of our current building, and that move will require us to thoughtfully restructure how we offer our Museum-based programs. We do not anticipate any changes to our Neary Lagoon and Pogonip Field trips, however the museum closure will impact our First Peoples and Animal Neighbors programs. We will be sending an update about these programs in October. services.name: Camp
services.desc: Through exploration, experimentation, and experiences outdoors the Santa Cruz Museum of Natural History hopes to inspire future scientists during our weekly day camps. Join us to discover a passion for nature, learning, and community. All Nature Explorers camps connect campers to their environment in fun and exciting ways that engage their natural sense of curiosity while supporting academic success. The Museum offers week-long day camps during Summer, Spring and Winter breaks for K-6th. We accept scholarship requests beginning 1 month prior to registration opening, and will notify you of your acceptance before registration begins.
